title: vBPF compatibility report
description: One file per tested environment in compat/<env>.json (see I-12). Rendered by scripts/render-compat.mjs into docs/compat.md and the README platform table. Statuses stay honest: nothing is marked verified without a recorded run.

env.description: Environment key, matches the compat/<env>.json filename.

status.description: verified: a matrix run completed and recorded this data. unverified: workflow exists but no green run yet. not-run: no run attempted.

kernel.description: uname -r output, or "n/a" when no run has recorded one.

bpftrace_version.description: First line of bpftrace --version, or "n/a" when unrecorded.

btf.description: Whether /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux was present at record time.

recorded_at.description: Optional record date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted for not-run stubs.

recipes.description: Per-recipe probe availability. fallback is reserved for recipes that declare a fallback path (none do yet).
